glosses: задавать признаки; метить; пометить; тегировать, ставить теги
Daten oder Text mithilfe von darstellbaren Zeichen (Tags) strukturieren

examples.text: Wie auf Facebook ist es auch auf dem Microblogging-Dienst Twitter möglich, andere Nutzer zu taggen.
Eine solche Policy dient auch dazu, Nutzer zu zwingen, beim Buchen eines Dienstes den Verantwortlichen und die Kostenstelle zu taggen.
Nach einem Klick auf das jeweilige Schlagwort lassen sich die Webseiten finden, die man selbst oder ein anderer Nutzer mit eben diesem Wort getaggt hat.
Beispielsweise taggen Sie die letzten Reisefotos aus Neapel mit den Stichwörtern „Neapel“, „Reise“, „Italien“, „Urlaub“ und der Jahreszahl.
Dabei kann man Mitglieder in Gruppen-Chats „taggen“, also mit einem @-Zeichen „markieren“, ähnlich wie bei Facebook, Instagram oder Twitter.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv, Informatik: Daten oder Text mithilfe von darstellbaren Zeichen (Tags) strukturieren

examples.text: He has a tag hung on his bag.

glosses: A skin tag, an excrescence of skin.
A dangling lock of sheep's wool, matted with dung; a dung tag.
Any slight appendage, as to an article of dress; something slight hanging loosely.
A metallic binding, tube, or point, at the end of a string, or lace, to stiffen it.
Any short peptide sequence artificially attached to proteins mostly in order to help purify, solubilize or visualize these proteins.
Something mean and paltry; the rabble, originally refer to rag as torn cloth.

examples.text: For upon the like Proclamation there, they all came in, both tag and rag

glosses: The last line (or last two lines) of a song's chorus that is repeated to indicate the end of the song.
The last scene of a TV program, often focusing on the program's subplot.

examples.text: Often, the tag punctuates the "we're all in this together" theme and is topped with a laugh.

glosses: The end, or catchword, of an actor's speech; cue.
An attribution in narrated dialogue (eg, \"he said\") or attributed words (e.g. \"he thought\").

examples.text: If you want to start with talk, stick a tag in right away
Seems here like Russ would be speaking. You could use a tag here.
You could combine these two paragraphs, I think, and rewrite to lose the tag portion of the third sentence.

glosses: A piece of markup representing an element in a markup language.

examples.text: The <title> tag provides a title for the Web page.
The <sarcasm> tag conveys sarcasm in Internet slang.

glosses: A keyword, term, or phrase associated with or assigned to data, media, and/or information enabling keyword-based classification; often used to categorize content.

examples.text: I want to add genre and artist tags to the files in my music collection.

glosses: A vehicle number plate; a medal bearing identification data (animals, soldiers).

examples.text: The subwoofer in the trunk was so loud, it vibrated the tag like an aluminum can.
What’s your tag?

glosses: A game, especially for children on playgrounds, in which one player (known as \"it\") attempts to touch another, who then becomes \"it\"; any similar game of chasing and trying to reach, touch, shoot, or label other players.
An instance of touching the baserunner with the ball or the ball in a gloved hand to rule him \"out.\

examples.text: The tag was applied at second for the final out.

glosses: Graffiti in the form of a stylized signature particular to the artist.

examples.text: There is a hierarchy of sorts: a throw-up can go over a tag, a piece over a throw-up, and a burner over a piece.

glosses: A sheep in its first year.

examples.text: After being weaned, the ram or wedder lamb is sometimes termed hog, hoggit, or tag, during the whole of the first year

glosses: To mark (something) with one's graffiti tag.
To remove dung tags from a sheep.

examples.text: Regularly tag the rear ends of your sheep.
He really tagged that ball.

glosses: to have sex with someone (especially a man of a woman)

examples.text: Steve is dying to tag Angie from chemistry class.

glosses: To put a runner out by touching them with the ball or the ball in a gloved hand.

examples.text: He tagged the runner for the out.

glosses: To mark with a tag (metadata for classification).

examples.text: I am tagging my music files by artist and genre.

glosses: To attach the name of (a user) to a posted message so that they are linked from the post and possibly sent a notification.

examples.text: One side wants to demonstrate a higher level of street knowledge and openly denounces the distorting lens of Instagram dissings; the other embraces the medium's branding affordances by sending “clout” to a third-party ally, while at the same time avoiding tagging the opponent.

glosses: To follow closely, accompany, tag along.

examples.text: A tall young man came striding through the park along the path near which she sat. Behind him tagged a boy carrying a suit-case.

glosses: To catch and touch (a player in the game of tag).
To fit with, or as if with, a tag or tags.

examples.text: He learned to make long-tagged thread laces.
His courteous host […] / Tags every sentence with some fawning word.

a. 1751, Henry St John, 1st Viscount Bolingbroke, an essay
they began to tag their law with the scraps of philofophy

glosses: A decoration drawn over some Hebrew letters in Jewish scrolls, especially in Stam style.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv, Informatik: Daten oder Text mithilfe von darstellbaren Zeichen (Tags) strukturieren

examples.text: Il commence à taguer dans la rue puis dans le métro new-yorkais.
Les étudiants de la Sorbonne en émeute taguèrent sur les murs : « Plus jamais Claudel ! » C'était prometteur pour Stendhal...

Le temps où Luke taguait le mur de l'école et où il volait de la bière à la supérette n'était plus qu'un lointain souvenir et les rides sur le visage de père Andrews prouvaient que son idéalisme s'était dissous dans une attitude beaucoup plus réaliste.

De l'autre, rassemblée sur la place, la population s'indignait. Même les bouffeurs de curés manifestaient leur colère. Qu'on taguât les cathédrales, qu'on manifestât dans les couvents, peu leur importait. Ces marques de protestation faisaient partie de la révolte ordinaire.

glosses: Ajouter un tag, une étiquette utilisé pour catégoriser des données.

examples.text: L’annotateur traite les métadonnées textuelles brutes pour les taguer avec des concepts définis dans des ontologies biomédicales et utilise la connaissance représentée dans les ontologies pour étendre ces annotations.

examples.text: Baliser l’entrée d’un port, l’embouchure d’un fleuve.
Baliser une passe.

glosses: Mettre des marques pour indiquer le chemin.

examples.text: Baliser un chemin de randonnée.
Un chemin balisé.
Lucile avait pour habitude de nous tenir informées de ses allées et venues, une manière de nous rassurer sans doute, ou de baliser sa propre trajectoire.
